'''Lunn''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWn" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Lunn was closely involved with [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Coric]] at [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. During the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], Lunn was killed along with most of [[Torrent Company/Legends|his company]].<ref name="TCWn" />

==Personality and traits==
As a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Lunn stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lunn first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TCWn" />
